reviewed_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD as seen in step 1

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the change does and whether anything survived refutation

severity.description: Only what must be fixed. A minor or a nit changes no code the author is going to touch and is dropped, not filed: 88% of the minors this method filed were never acted on (#1936)

kind.description: spec is a finding against the requirement contract: missing work, or work the contract did not ask for (step 5b)

failure.description: Concrete input or state -> wrong result

evidence.description: What was read, with file:line at the pinned SHA, and why refutation failed

rung.description: Evidence rung: 4 is a command run that would fail loudly if the claim were wrong, 5 is the failure reproduced live. A candidate below 4 is dropped, not filed
